briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as major labs release advanced reasoning models amid surging compute investments. Regulatory pressure mounts while safety gaps persist in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multimodal chain-of-thought; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 hits 92% on GPQA at fraction of Western costs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI activates 200k H200 cluster in Memphis; Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k scale; Microsoft commits $15B to European AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models from China close the capability gap with US labs before 2027?
